abstract: In this issue of Cell Genomics, Dr. Jiarui Ding presents his paper, "ProtoCloud: A prototypical self-explaining model for single-cell analysis." Dr. Ding is an assistant professor in Computer Science at the University of British Columbia in Vancouver, Canada. He describes the scientific journey he undertook to publish this study and the current topics his lab is exploring.
